name: ekt_theta_grid
why: grid points on the visible arc of a mouth in the inner (aim) search

name: ekt_nu_grid
why: grid points of the contact-normal angle in the middle search

name: ekt_polish_dps
why: working precision when a bracketed root is polished with findroot

name: ekt_verify_tol
why: tolerance of the verifier (distances, speeds, residuals) at polish precision

name: ekt_max_split
why: halvings of an s-interval whose root count changes before it is reported as unresolved

name: ekt_jump_ratio
why: a bracketed sign change is a root only if the refined |f| falls below this fraction of the end values (rejects jumps)

name: ekt_bisect_rel_tol
why: bisection stops at this fraction of the bracket width (floats); with mpmath, 10^-(dps-8)

name: ekt_float_depth
why: floats are used while k log10(2/B) is below this; mpmath above (itinerary windows ~ (B/2)^k)

name: ekt_future_traversals
why: traversals followed after the collision when the verifier builds the history

name: ekt_s_grid
why: points of the uniform part of the outer grid of collision positions

name: ekt_s_far
why: farthest collision position searched, in D, along the incoming line (before the traversal) or the exit line (after)

name: ekt_s_near_over_R
why: closest collision position to the line's mouth-2 entry searched before the traversal, as a fraction of R

name: ekt_s_near_after
why: closest collision position to the mouth-1 exit searched after the traversal, in D

name: ekt_refine_max_split
why: further halvings of an unresolved nu- or s-interval in the adaptive refinement of the empty case

name: ekt_window_grid
why: extra collision positions in each refinement window around a known special point

name: ekt_cert_chunks
why: pieces of the s range of the empty case run as separate interval-exclusion tasks (parallelism only)

name: ekt_cert_control_budget
why: boxes per piece of s in the positive control when the piece holds no known solution (the rest is reported as not examined)

name: ekt_cert_control_sol_budget
why: boxes per piece of s in the positive control when the piece holds a known solution (the rest is reported as not examined)

name: ekt_refine_factor
why: grid refinement factor of the stabilization search (empty case)

name: kt_series_tol
why: the eqs. 66-67 series stops when (b xi / 2D)^N is below this

name: dps
why: working precision in decimal digits (mpmath)

name: delta
why: point-splitting distance along z, units of length

name: h
why: finite-difference step (must be < delta), units of length

name: n_terms
why: image pairs summed explicitly before the Kummer tail

name: kt_split_ratio
why: point-splitting distance / distance to the horizon, Kim & Thorne runs

name: kt_step_ratio
why: finite-difference step / distance to the horizon, Kim & Thorne runs

name: kt_quad_dps
why: working precision of the F6 integrals

name: kt_throat_thickness
why: a / b, angular cutoff tan(theta) < b / a for eqs. 53-54

name: thermal_n_terms
why: imaginary-time image pairs summed explicitly before the Kummer tail

name: thermal_split_ratio
why: point-splitting distance / beta in the thermal arbiter

name: thermal_step_ratio
why: finite-difference step / beta in the thermal arbiter

name: thermal_mode_dps
why: working precision of the mode integral

name: thermal_mode_intervals
why: subintervals of the mode integral

name: thermal_mode_pairs
why: image pairs summed in the image-versus-mode comparison

name: thermal_mode_cutoff
why: mode integral stops at k = cutoff / beta, where n_k ~ e^-60

name: kt_f5_limit_n
why: N at which the N -> infinity limits of F5 (eqs. 44a, 63) are evaluated
